description: Drive the real Claude Code CLI against the local model double: the scripted main session spawns pan-executor, and the executor subagent's request must carry the package's pan-executor body whole.
why: Program H1 and the MI-015 bug class: a package or an install that truncates an agent file leaves every file-level test green while the model never sees half its instructions. Only the request the host actually sends can show it. The double answers from a script, so nothing is spent and the check runs at tier 0, in CI as well (ADR-0047 D2, amended 2026-10-12).

steps.prompt: Spawn the pan-executor agent once, then report.

input.prompt: Reply with EXECUTOR-DONE and nothing else.

steps.why: The host ran end to end against the double: the main session (the request that offers the spawn tool) spawned the executor and finished after its result.
Every non-empty line of the packaged pan-executor body appears in the system prompt the host sent for the subagent. A truncating package or install would leave lines out.

write.content:
---
name: pan-executor
description: Executes a PAN plan.
tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob
---

You are a PAN plan executor. Execute the plan you are given.

controls.why: An installed agent cut down to its first lines (what a truncating install leaves) must turn the whole-body check red.
